page: UpCloud PREMIUM-24xCPU-96GB is a general-purpose cloud server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 shared vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor with an x86_64 architecture running at 2.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 400 GB SSD, and the server includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks reveal top-tier single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression scores placing in the top 10%. Multi-core performance is strong, ranking in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core tests. However, memory performance presents a notable tradeoff; while read-only memory bandwidth is average, large-block write bandwidth and PassMark memory scores fall into the bottom 25%.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this server offers a high density of physical cores and a balanced resource profile suitable for multi-threaded workloads without the premium cost of dedicated CPU allocations. Given the strong multi-core processing and average database and web serving throughput, this instance is well-suited for multi-threaded application hosting, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations.
